- Naomi Watts made her screen debut in the Australian drama film For Love Alone in 1986 and then appeared in the Australian television series Hey Dad..!.
- Ellie Parker is a 2005 American drama-comedy film written and directed by Scott Coffey.
- In Ellie Parker, Naomi Watts plays the title character, a young actress struggling in Los Angeles.
- In 2005, Built Like Alaska provided the score for Scott Coffey's film Ellie Parker and spent much of the summer touring the United States.
- Built Like Alaska later completed work on an untitled third album that the band recorded in Oakdale and that Lucky Lew mixed at Wave Parade in Modesto.
